citations.text: T. Safavi, D. Koutra (2020). CoDEx: A Comprehensive Knowledge Graph Completion Benchmark. Proceedings of the 4th Conference on Automated Knowledge Base Construction.

description: Small knowledge graph from the CoDEx (Comprehensive Distillation and Extraction) benchmark. Extracted from Wikidata and Wikipedia. Contains 42 relation types connecting entities, with 337 entity pairs having multiple relation types. Directed triples (head, relation, tail) format.
name: CoDEx-S Knowledge Graph
